name: Text Scroll Widget
author: jiteshgondaliya

sections.description:
Text Scroll Widget helps you showcase news, notices, and announcements with smooth scrolling text. Version 3 is a full rebuild: secure, accessible, and easy to manage.

Highlights

  • Dedicated Text Scroll admin menu (Dashboard, Tickers, Settings, Docs)
  • Ticker manager with multiple messages — add, edit, delete, duplicate, drag-and-drop reorder
  • Live preview in the editor (horizontal and vertical)
  • Three free templates: Minimal, Announcement bar, News ticker
  • Classic widget (existing sidebar widgets keep working after upgrade)
  • Shortcode: [text_scroll id="123"] or [text_scroll direction="left" speed="3"]Your message[/text_scroll]
  • Gutenberg block
  • PHP helper: tsw_the_ticker( $id )
  • Modes: continuous marquee, fade, static announcement
  • Speed, start delay, gap, pause on hover/focus, accessible pause/play control
  • Colors, font size & weight, padding, radius, soft shadow
  • Respects prefers-reduced-motion and supports RTL
  • Per-widget direction/speed with global defaults
  • Optional delete-data-on-uninstall (off by default)

Accessibility

Animated tickers include a pause/play button. Hover and focus can also pause scrolling. When the visitor prefers reduced motion, auto-animation is disabled and content stays manually scrollable.

Pro (premium build)

Unlimited tickers, advanced animations, dynamic sources (posts, WooCommerce, RSS), Elementor, sticky bars, analytics, import/export, and Agency white-label. Licensing is handled via Freemius.

Third-party services

This plugin may use Freemius for optional account, licensing, and upgrade flows.

  • Freemius connects only after you opt in from the plugin UI. Skipping opt-in keeps all free features working.
  • When you opt in or purchase Pro, Freemius may process account details needed for licensing, checkout, and support (for example site URL, admin email, and license status) according to the Freemius Privacy Policy.
  • The plugin does not ship a Freemius secret key. Only a product ID and public key are included in code.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install via Plugins → Add New.
  2. Activate Text Scroll Widget.
  3. Open Text Scroll in the admin menu.
  4. Create a ticker, or use the classic Text Scrolling widget / shortcode / block.

See INSTALL.md in the plugin package for premium/Freemius notes.
sections.faq:
Will my existing widgets still work after updating?

Yes. Widgets with title and description continue to work and inherit the global direction and speed unless you override them per widget.

How do I show a managed ticker?

Create a ticker under Text Scroll → Tickers, then use [text_scroll id="123"], the block, or tsw_the_ticker( 123 );.

Can I change direction and speed?

Yes. Set global defaults under Text Scroll → Settings, or set them per ticker, widget, shortcode, or block.

How many tickers can I create on the free plan?

The free plan allows up to 2 tickers. Pro unlocks unlimited tickers.

Is import/export included in free?

No. Import/export is a Pro feature.

Does the plugin phone home?

Freemius is bundled for optional opt-in, licensing, and upgrades. It does not connect until you opt in; skipping opt-in keeps the free plugin fully functional. See Third-party services above.
sections.changelog:
3.0.2

  • Fix: pause/play control no longer overlaps scrolling text (flex layout).
  • Fix: horizontal/announcement bar vertically centers text with the control; symmetrical padding.
  • Docs: screenshot captions updated.

3.0.1

  • Fix: hide Upgrade nags when a Freemius Pro license is active.
  • Fix: unlock Pro via Freemius can_use_premium_code() (license), not only premium-build flag.
  • Fix: Add New ticker redirect before admin headers; editor submenu access.
  • Free plan: max 2 tickers; Pro unlimited.
  • Freemius SDK in vendor/freemius/; uninstall via after_uninstall.

3.0.0

  • Security: sanitize on save, escape on output (fixes stored XSS).
  • Replace deprecated marquee with CSS animations and vanilla JS.
  • Ticker CPT, message repeater, templates, live preview editor.
  • Top-level Text Scroll admin menu (Dashboard, Tickers, Settings, Docs, Upgrade).
  • Shortcode (inline + id), Gutenberg block, tsw_the_ticker().
  • Pause/play control, reduced-motion, RTL, i18n pot.
  • Freemius-ready Pro modules in premium build only (__premium_only).
  • Optional delete-data-on-uninstall; per-instance direction/speed with global defaults.

2.4

  • Solve Bug Related Text.

2.3

  • Solve Bug Related Text.

1.0

  • Initial release.
